listing.name: Icewind Dale II (GemRB)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Official GemRB SourceForge desktop archives, Flatpak, or documented source build; provide original supported Infinity Engine installation and configure GamePath or positional game directory. Enhanced Edition support kept separate. Limits: Original supported games completable upstream; Planescape less polished, no multiplayer. Enhanced Edition support is separately experimental/unsupported. Upstream platforms: Official SourceForge Windows/Linux/macOS downloads and Flatpak. README documents Linux x86/x86-64/PPC/MIPS historical/source targets; selected artifact CPU is unknown until chosen. Original data: Supply installed original Icewind Dale II game data for this GemRB target; the included trivial demo is not the full game. Non-Windows users can copy a Windows installation, use a compatible installer/WINE, or extract CDs with unshield. Exact supported localization/patch and optional expansion combination remain Unknown here; do not substitute Enhanced Edition data. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
